properties.comment: OCEC crews are taking an unexpected outage to replace a pole on Ski Run Road that was broken when a tree fell through the line. This outage will affect Sierra Vista, Ski Run Road, and Villa Madonna. Sierra Vista area may only be out for a short time, while those affected on Ski Run Road and Villa Madonna should expect to be out until 5 PM. Outage will begin at 12:40 PM.
